name: The Void Coronation
text: Sacrifice Shinobi whose stars total 10 or more, including a commander. The shadow that outlived every name takes the field.

name: The Iron Tide
text: Sacrifice Samurai whose stars total 10 or more, including a commander. The banner passes to the one who never yields it.

name: The Broken Oath
text: Sacrifice Knights whose stars total 10 or more, including a commander. A crown taken by breaking the vow that made it.

name: The Elder Ascent
text: Sacrifice dragons whose stars total 9 or more. The brood gives up its strongest so the oldest may wake.

name: Invocation of Memory
text: With a ritualist channelling, sacrifice units whose stars total 12 or more. What was hidden is shown.

name: Invocation of Torment
text: With a ritualist channelling, sacrifice units whose stars total 12 or more. Fear becomes weight on the field.

name: Invocation of Reincarnation
text: With a ritualist channelling, sacrifice units whose stars total 12 or more. The fallen return wearing other shapes.

name: Paired Line
text: Two foot soldiers of one theme lock into a single fighting pair. One hex, one slot, greater weight.

name: Gate Wardens
text: The Oni-Gate Champion takes a spear-bearer into the duel line.

name: Twinwing Drake
text: Two drakes lock talons and fly as one larger body.

name: The Calamity Form
text: Only when Memory, Torment and Reincarnation stand together does the convergence become possible. It does not last.

name: Forced March
text: Target one of your platoons. It drives at forced pace for the rest of the round: +3 MOV to every member.

name: Smokescreen
text: Target a hex. Smoke rolls across it and every hex around it for two rounds, breaking sightlines and giving anyone inside cover.

name: False Retreat
text: Target one of your platoons. It breaks and runs, then turns on whoever gave chase: +3 MOV and +100 ATK for the rest of the round, at -50 DEF while the ruse holds.
